description: Draft a self-contained, paste-ready prompt for handing work off to another Claude Code session. Use when the user wants to brief a parallel session, transfer a task to a fresh session, codify a multi-step workflow as a reusable prompt, or coordinate work across multiple sessions or machines. Trigger phrases include "draft a handoff prompt", "prepare a transfer prompt", "write a paste-block for another session", "I need to brief another session", "prompt for another session".
